correctness.rationale: Exact pinned proof: the kernel is a central mixture of subgroup-averaged orthogonal projections, so Fourier scalars are nonnegative and equal to f^{lambda/(k)}/f^lambda by Young branching, with regular-representation multiplicity (f^lambda)^2. For nontrivial lambda, conditioning on first k tableau labels in row one, a specified minimal cell in the second row is first in at least 1/(n-k) of linear extensions; telescope to f^{lambda/(k)}/f^lambda <= (n-k)/(n-1), sharp for (n-1,1). Include k=0 separately, leading to eta_*=(n-E K-w_0)/(n-1), gap=(E K+w_0-1)/(n-1); Pr[K>=2]>0 iff transpositions possible. Independent finite S_3 and S_4 transition/eigenvalue checks corroborated several fixed-size values; no extrapolation from them.
residual_risks: Complete n<=6 verifier output quoted by source was not treated as a universal proof.
